full_translation_en:
Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2082
First Session
Meeting Number - 4
Daily Agenda
Wednesday, Chaitra 25, 2082
1:00 PM
1. The Honorable Speaker will read out a letter received from the Office of the President regarding the order of precedence.
2. The Honorable Speaker will set a date for the election of the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives in accordance with Rule 8 of the House of Representatives Regulations, 2079.
3. The Honorable Prime Minister, Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda', will present the "Seventh Annual Report of the National Natural Resources and Fiscal Commission, 2082".
4. The Honorable Minister of Finance, Dr. Swarnim Wagle:
(a) Will present a proposal seeking permission to introduce the "Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082".
(b) Will introduce the "Alternative Development Finance Mobilization Bill, 2082".

Padma Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
